bulletins.title: Fake Microsoft Scans Push Antivirus Removal and Refund Scams
bulletins.summary: Fraudulent websites branded as Microsoft security scanners claim third-party antivirus software is unsupported and causing critical system errors. Victims are urged to uninstall their security tools and contact fake support agents for refunds, enabling remote access and financial theft.
phrases: Windows no longer supports third-party antivirus

bulletins.title: Fake Veterans Savings Program Postcards Phish for Personal Info
bulletins.summary: Scammers send official-looking postcards falsely claiming recipients qualify for extra monthly military benefits under a nonexistent program. Responding to the mailers directs targets to fraudulent intake lines designed to steal identity and banking details.
phrases: qualify for extra monthly veterans benefits

bulletins.title: Predatory Debt Relief Promises Settle Taxes for Pennies on the Dollar
bulletins.summary: Deceptive tax relief companies target consumers owing back taxes with unrealistic promises to eliminate debt before reviewing records. Scammers collect steep upfront service fees while leaving taxpayers in worse standing with authorities.
phrases: settle your debt for pennies on the dollar
get rid of your tax debt
upfront service fee for tax relief

bulletins.title: Social Media Honeytraps Extort Teens for Instant Digital Payments
bulletins.summary: Extortion rings pose as flirtatious peers on social platforms to coerce victims into sending compromising photographs. Scammers immediately threaten public exposure unless victims transmit rapid funds via digital cash apps or retail gift cards.
phrases: send money via Cash App or gift cards
send payment or I will post these pictures
threatening to release your private photos
send gift card codes right now

gemini_context_snippet: Active campaigns this week include tech-support lures instructing users to uninstall antivirus for fake refunds, mailers promoting a fictitious 'Veterans Savings Program', tax settlement scams promising resolution for 'pennies on the dollar', and social media sextortion demanding Cash App payments.
